criteria.title: Custom links render in the left navbar
criteria.blocker: Sidebar component does not render in automated Playwright browser context despite valid auth tokens and facility navigation. Auth tokens obtained from backend API and injected into localStorage, but application shows login form. Attempted direct navigation to /facility/1/overview with multiple selector strategies ([data-sidebar=sidebar], aside, nav[role=navigation]) - all failed.

seed_attempt.summary: Obtained fresh JWT tokens via POST /api/v1/auth/login/ with credentials (admin/admin). Created localStorage state with care_access_token and care_refresh_token. Attempted UI navigation to facility and direct URL navigation to /facility/{id}/overview. Sidebar component did not render in Playwright context.
